# Tensor Debug Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement developer-facing debug formatting so tensors expose stable metadata (`shape`, `strides`, `dtype`, `layout`) and reuse the same logical-order truncation rules as Display without duplicating the trailing shape suffix.

**Architecture:** `src/format/debug.rs` owns the internal dtype mapper and the `Debug for TensorBase<S, D>` implementation. It delegates the data block to `pretty.rs` while keeping the public element bound at `A: Debug`.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, std, `core::any::TypeId`, `core::fmt`

**Design Docs:** `design/22-output.md` §5.3 (Debug), §5.4 (layout examples), §5.5 (shared truncation contract), §6.2 (dtype mapping)

**Prerequisites:** W25T1 and W25T2 must be complete.

---

### Task 1: Implement dtype mapping and the Debug output path

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/format/debug.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the complete debug implementation**

Write `src/format/debug.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use crate::complex::Complex;
use crate::dimension::Dimension;
use crate::element::Element;
use crate::format::pretty::fmt_debug_data;
use crate::storage::Storage;
use crate::tensor::TensorBase;

fn dtype_name<A: Element + 'static>() -> &'static str {
    match core::any::TypeId::of::<A>() {
        id if id == core::any::TypeId::of::<f32>() => "f32",
        id if id == core::any::TypeId::of::<f64>() => "f64",
        id if id == core::any::TypeId::of::<i32>() => "i32",
        id if id == core::any::TypeId::of::<i64>() => "i64",
        id if id == core::any::TypeId::of::<Complex<f32>>() => "Complex<f32>",
        id if id == core::any::TypeId::of::<Complex<f64>>() => "Complex<f64>",
        id if id == core::any::TypeId::of::<bool>() => "bool",
        _ => core::any::type_name::<A>(),
    }
}

impl<S, D, A> core::fmt::Debug for TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension,
    A: core::fmt::Debug + Element + 'static,
{
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        write!(
            f,
            "Tensor(shape={:?}, strides={:?}, dtype={}, layout=",
            self.shape(),
            self.strides(),
            dtype_name::<A>()
        )?;

        if self.strides().iter().any(|&stride| stride == 0) {
            write!(f, "broadcast")?;
        } else if self.is_f_contiguous() {
            write!(f, "f-contiguous")?;
        } else {
            write!(f, "non-contiguous")?;
        }

        write!(f, ")\n")?;
        fmt_debug_data(f, self)
    }
}
```
